ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the Waterway Residential-Business Planned Development 1439
indications as shown on Map No. 5-G in the area bounded by:

North Kingsbury Street; a line beginning at a point 249 feet south of West Cortland Street as
measured along the west line of North Kingsbury Street, such line extending northwestwardly a
distance of 33.45 feet running at 67 degrees, 38 minutes, 02 seconds; a line extending from the
aforementioned resulting point northeasterly at 90 degrees for a distance of 11.94 feet to the
western right of way line of North Kingsbury Street as extended

        to those of M3-3 Heavy Industry District, and a corresponding use district is hereby
established in the area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.

Common Address of Property:

1938 North Kingsbury Street, Chicago, Illinois.
